dedupe_keys.name: s1s2 water a global dataset for semantic segmentation of water bodies from sentinel 1 and sentinel 2 satellite images

description: German Aerospace Center researchers and collaborators publish S1S2-Water, a global benchmark for identifying surface water in Sentinel-1 radar and Sentinel-2 optical imagery. Version 1.0.1, released in May 2024 under CC BY 4.0, contains sixty-five image pairs with manually checked water and valid-pixel masks, elevation and slope layers. Samples follow approximately 100-kilometre Sentinel-2 tiles. The repository README documents UTM-projected GeoTIFF rasters, STAC metadata, scaled radar backscatter and optical reflectance, and a Python preparation workflow. This version restores missing Sentinel-1 scenes for two samples. The data can calibrate water-mapping components used in flood-exposure and infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this benchmark. It is a sampled reference collection, not continuous flood monitoring. Acquisition dates vary by scene; annotation uncertainty and the suitability of splits for a new region need checking. Data are free; the separate preparation repository has no licence identified in its metadata. No imagery or code was executed.
